Agentic AI is rewriting the business development playbook for chipmakers and server builders. Graphics processing units still grab the headlines, but as supercomputing and AI converge, the next wave of demand is landing on central processing units that must fit inside the power budgets data centers already have. The shift has been building for years. […]
